About me

Who I Am

I'm a Computer Science postgraduate student at Tikaram Jagannath College, Pune, specialising in data analysis, visualisation, and machine learning. My passion is finding patterns in complex datasets and translating them into clear, actionable decisions.

Through internships at Cognifyz Technologies (Power BI) and CodSoft IT Services (Data Science), I've built production-level dashboards and executed complete ML pipelines — from raw data to containerised deployment with Docker and GitHub Actions.

I hold an Oracle AI Foundation Associate certification and a Google Digital Marketing certificate. I'm actively seeking entry-level Data Analyst roles where I can add real value from day one.

"I believe data storytelling is just as important as data analysis — insights mean nothing if they can't be communicated clearly."
